Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Hearts of Three", "unit": 12, "heading": "CHAPTER X", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "ru78-u012-r0062", "target": "Тень улыбки скользнула по губам предводителя, когда он приказал своим людям перерезать верёвки, которые так обидно выставляли напоказ неравенство, на какое жаловался Генри.", "source_sha256": "b3e2189166d590f3151fe42d936dad84d2a1bf3b7bfc32462353e67f20ddc2b8", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u012-r0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "4449df1ae34e598e160c41515daa838e2a9b19bce147b1b7f36903ccb648beca"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u012-r0063", "target": "— Ха! — ухмыльнулся Фрэнсис, обращаясь к Леонсии и Генри. — Смутно припоминаю, что где-то миллион лет назад я жил в тихом старом городишке под названием Нью-Йорк, где мы по глупости считали себя самыми буйными и самыми порочными из всех, кто когда-либо бил по мячу для гольфа, отправлял на электрический стул инспектора полиции, сражался с Таммани или объявлял четыре «нулло» при пяти верных взятках на собственных руках.", "source_sha256": "d1af4c2b2f9329ba3bd7a5160bb11363fe0a08c7a8a8ab78738b1b1851c00217", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u012-r0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5e59a3b94a66314fe629ba922357fb0ac84d258b7ec7ba659ab8855d4d4e1a02"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u012-r0064", "tag": "p", "text": "“Huh!” Henry vouchsafed half an hour later, as the trail, from a lesser crest, afforded a view of higher crests beyond. “Huh! and hell’s bells! These gunny-sack chaps are not animals of savages. Look, Henry! They are semaphoring! See that near tree there, and that big one across the canyon. Watch the branches wave.”", "sha256": "8869f1c31d8ce118706c99264d539aec396fdae1a38c096ded422dbc6373e6a8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[972]", "source_html": "

“Huh!” Henry vouchsafed half an hour later, as the trail, from a lesser crest, afforded a view of higher crests beyond. “Huh! and hell’s bells! These gunny-sack chaps are not animals of savages. Look, Henry! They are semaphoring! See that near tree there, and that big one across the canyon. Watch the branches wave.”

When the bandages were removed, they found themselves in a vast and lofty cavern, lighted by many torches, and, confronting them, a blind and white-haired man in sackcloth seated on a rock-hewn throne, with, beneath him, her shoulder at his knees, a pretty mestiza woman.", "sha256": "329124c15cf4a459c79dea86d441c4f1ec7880f3e8523272d0bc92f74c517cdf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[973]", "source_html": "

Blindfold for a number of miles at the last, the prisoners, still blindfolded, were led into the cave where the Cruel Justice reigned. When the bandages were removed, they found themselves in a vast and lofty cavern, lighted by many torches, and, confronting them, a blind and white-haired man in sackcloth seated on a rock-hewn throne, with, beneath him, her shoulder at his knees, a pretty mestiza woman.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0066", "tag": "p", "text": "The blind man spoke, and in his voice was the thin and bell-like silver of age and weary wisdom.", "sha256": "9daa983314ebf5b76a3959974d6299f1a4fa2a59fd1be88b76287a50c645177c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[974]", "source_html": "

The blind man spoke, and in his voice was the thin and bell-like silver of age and weary wisdom.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0067", "tag": "p", "text": "“The Cruel Justice has been invoked. Speak! Who demands decision and equity?”", "sha256": "290718d5177c6556946083784e6914c09b006fe92799cb1ae365da2febccdce2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[975]", "source_html": "

“The Cruel Justice has been invoked. Speak! Who demands decision and equity?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0068", "tag": "p", "text": "All held back, and not even the Jefe could summon heart of courage to protest against Cordilleras law.", "sha256": "8b0b7b6563ff79df8eb99618ddc32b50b1cfe67a44c1a7ebc646c7546560bfd7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[976]", "source_html": "

All held back, and not even the Jefe could summon heart of courage to protest against Cordilleras law.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0069", "tag": "p", "text": "“There is a woman present,” continued the Blind Brigand. “Let her speak first. All mortal men and women are guilty of something or else are charged by their fellows with some guilt.”", "sha256": "122599e55e66646b55a0da085dec730527ed54c0516415cb006ee8d62528baf7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[977]", "source_html": "

“There is a woman present,” continued the Blind Brigand. “Let her speak first. All mortal men and women are guilty of something or else are charged by their fellows with some guilt.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0070", "tag": "p", "text": "Henry and Francis were for with-straining her, but with an equal smile to them she addressed the Cruel Just One in clear and ringing tones:", "sha256": "ab6695f756056d5653cf565d1c9897a29d3763cf4951ea9bc295665a55e38eb8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[978]", "source_html": "

Henry and Francis were for with-straining her, but with an equal smile to them she addressed the Cruel Just One in clear and ringing tones:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0071", "tag": "p", "text": "“I only have aided the man I am engaged to marry to escape from death for a murder he did not commit.”", "sha256": "5935f3ba08e5567290d4550567693047d542285289c2f102959c9f67b62cd9ec", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[979]", "source_html": "

“I only have aided the man I am engaged to marry to escape from death for a murder he did not commit.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0072", "tag": "p", "text": "“You have spoken,” said the Blind Brigand. “Come forward to me.”", "sha256": "5e133ff5b0c2be3402efadb8ed6b45155245d4241e403e867ec33c7d522473d4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[980]", "source_html": "

“You have spoken,” said the Blind Brigand. “Come forward to me.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0073", "tag": "p", "text": "Piloted by sackcloth men, while the two Morgans who loved her were restless and perturbed, she was made to kneel at the blind man’s knees. The mestiza girl placed his hand on Leoncia’s head. For a full and solemn minute silence obtained, while the steady fingers of the Blind One rested about her forehead and registered the pulse-beats of her temples. Then he removed his hand and leaned back to decision.", "sha256": "255c9378dfce0fdc198e3b1cfd5d3f5e351ba210b9c0bdbf7736554d6ce4f2b3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[981]", "source_html": "

Piloted by sackcloth men, while the two Morgans who loved her were restless and perturbed, she was made to kneel at the blind man’s knees. The mestiza girl placed his hand on Leoncia’s head. For a full and solemn minute silence obtained, while the steady fingers of the Blind One rested about her forehead and registered the pulse-beats of her temples. Then he removed his hand and leaned back to decision.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0074", "tag": "p", "text": "“Arise, Senorita,” he pronounced. “Your heart is clean of evil. “Arise, Senorita,” he pronounced. “Your heart is clean 107of evil. You go free.—Who else appeals to the Cruel Justice?”

Francis immediately stepped forward.
